_doc: Master tag list for events. Reuse an existing tag whenever one fits; add a new tag here (kebab-case, one-line description) only when none does. `./run query --tags` shows usage counts.

tags.solar: Solar System, Sun and planets other than Earth; pre-Earth events
tags.moon: Formation and history of the Moon, including lunar craters and tides
tags.impact: Asteroid or comet impacts and impact craters, on Earth or elsewhere
tags.magnetic: Earth's magnetic field: origin, reversals, superchrons, excursions
tags.tectonics: Crust, continents, plate tectonics, rifting and ocean basins
tags.supercontinent: Assembly or breakup of a supercontinent (Columbia, Rodinia, Pangaea, ...)
tags.mountains: Formation of a named mountain range or peak
tags.volcanic: Large eruptions, large igneous provinces, volcanic winters
tags.atmosphere: Composition of the air: oxygen, carbon dioxide, methane, ozone
tags.ocean: Ocean chemistry, temperature, circulation and named oceans
tags.climate: Climate state: greenhouse or icehouse, warm events, temperature
tags.glaciation: Ice ages, glaciations and Snowball Earth episodes
tags.cycles: Biogeochemical cycles: carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulfur
tags.origin-of-life: Prebiotic chemistry, the first cells, LUCA, earliest evidence of life
tags.innovation: Biological first: a new structure or ability (eyes, bones, eggs, photosynthesis, ...)
tags.animals: Animals in general, or a group not covered by a narrower tag
tags.primates: Primates, monkeys and apes, excluding hominins
tags.hominins: Human lineage after the split from chimpanzees
tags.ancestor: Early relative of an organism a reader would recognize today
tags.ecosystem: New kind of ecosystem or landscape: reefs, forests, grasslands, pollination, predation
tags.extinction: Mass extinction or major biotic crisis
tags.first: Earliest known occurrence of something (combine with a topic tag)
tags.era: Named geological interval or its character (Cambrian explosion, Age of ...)
tags.debated: Date, cause or reality of the event is debated; the text says so
tags.interior: Earth's deep interior: core, mantle, differentiation
tags.galaxy: The Milky Way and the Sun's path through it: bubbles, gas clouds, nearby supernovae, gamma-ray bursts, neighbouring galaxies
tags.behaviour: First evidence of a behaviour: parental care, song, farming, tool use, fire
tags.record: Record holder: largest, smallest, oldest, longest-lived of its kind
